## Static distribution gap at PR #19 head

At `00d770c81d98784e75a1aaaa1d6838e21dafe604`, the [package manifest](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-evidence/blob/00d770c81d98784e75a1aaaa1d6838e21dafe604/package.json) points `main` and `types` to `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.d.ts`. The complete [Git tree](https://api.github.com/repos/unbraind/pm-evidence/git/trees/00d770c81d98784e75a1aaaa1d6838e21dafe604?recursive=1) is untruncated and contains **no dist entries**.

This conflicts with the explicit distribution decision in [pm-evidence-fragment-text-sdk](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-evidence/blob/00d770c81d98784e75a1aaaa1d6838e21dafe604/.agents/pm/tasks/pm-evidence-fragment-text-sdk.toon), which says compiled JavaScript/declarations are included so commit-pinned npm/Bun consumers disabling lifecycle scripts receive the entrypoint. [PR #19](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-evidence/pull/19) repeats that claim. The source export itself exists, but source is not the configured package entrypoint.

### Expected / actual / impact
Expected: the exact approved immutable consumer revision can supply its documented public `resolveFragmentText` root export and declarations without lifecycle execution, as required for [pm-web #278](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/pull/278).
Actual static artifact: the configured compiled entrypoints are absent from the commit. A locally built packed tarball may pass while this commit-consumption path remains unsatisfied. Do not infer that source tests or prepack-generated artifacts prove the promised lifecycle-disabled Git revision journey.

### Acceptance
- Supply the intended supported consumer artifact/entrypoints, or revise the explicit distribution decision and consumer instructions to an artifact that actually exists; do not require consumers to bypass lifecycle restrictions.
- Test npm and Bun installation of the exact documented revision/artifact with lifecycle scripts disabled and import `resolveFragmentText` from the package root; verify declaration resolution too.
- Retain exact raw large-number/exponent/escaped-string/pointer results and no-I/O resolver semantics.
- Record source commit, actual installed artifact identity, commands and outcomes separately from npm publication.

### Limits and dedup
Static finding, not a locally executed package-install failure. No installation, lifecycle script, security restriction change or native provider operation was attempted. All 19 existing all-status issues/PRs, the current PR inline comments (empty) and the canonical feature task were checked; no separate missing-entrypoint owner was found. Pure source resolver checks passed 5,000 bounded in-memory assertions on Node24 with retained dependencies; that does not validate package distribution.
Commit-pinned fragment SDK lacks the compiled entrypoints promised for scripts-disabled consumers
